concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Actual concept inspected. REJECT its large external terminal denture/jaw: instead small ventral-anterior supporting patch with two rows of small teeth tucked under anterior body. REJECT overregular equal scales and conical-looking thick spines: actual build differentiated scale zones, posterior overlap and flattened narrow blade spines of unequal length. Retain oval complete body and naked continuous underside. Eight trunk rows, per adult half-row3 dorsal+4 upper-lateral+1 lower-lateral+5 sickle ventrolateral scales; paired anterior fan is additional ninth organization.9 blade spines per side is within adult7–11 range. Use sparse raised longitudinal ridge relief as low-poly shorthand, NOT literal9–15 ribs. Large foot continuous and unsegmented, no legs/eyes/tentacles. Closed real volumes. Supplemental clean-import ventral diagnostic separate from exact8 canonical proof to expose foot and feeding apparatus.
